verdict.rationale: Okta's official MCP server enables natural-language operations like creating users, listing failed logins, or finding unused apps, evidenced by first-party blog docs and the okta-mcp-server GitHub repo with concrete NL command examples. However this is a separate add-on tool rather than native NL control built into the core admin console/product itself, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: native in-product NL interface (not just an external MCP server), independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's command coverage and accuracy.
